title: Canonical Evidence Report Alignment Before Official Launch
what_was_stale: SCIENTIFIC_EVIDENCE_PROFILE.md showed Algorithm Card = ❌ for all four algorithms (grin, stgcn, ignnk, dcrnn)
SCIENTIFIC_EVIDENCE_PROFILE.md showed convergence_caveated for all four algorithms

SCIENTIFIC_EVIDENCE_PROFILE.md contained hardcoded pre-rerun wording in sections 9, 10, 11: 'metrics absent before the scientific rerun', 'artifact slots missing before the scientific rerun', 'mask bank metadata not yet discoverable'
SCIENTIFIC_GATE_REPORT.md/json showed global_status=BLOCKED despite 11/11 global checks passing
SCIENTIFIC_GATE_REPORT algorithm-level statuses were BLOCKED with algorithm_cards_not_ready for all four algorithms while global SCI-FIX05 check said PASS — internal contradiction

convergence_report.json showed convergence_caveated or validation_loss_missing because Phase C runs (100 epochs, no _validation_split injection) had overwritten training_record.json files with validation_loss=None

root_causes_identified.label: Algorithm cards timing issue
root_causes_identified.description: SCI-FIX08 algorithm_coverage.csv was generated at 14:00 UTC before algorithm_card_readiness_report.json existed (created 16:23 UTC). _load_algorithm_card_report() returned None so algorithm_card_ready=False for all algorithms.

root_causes_identified.label: Phase C training record overwrite
root_causes_identified.description: Phase C runs (epochs=100, implementation_variant=None, no validation_split) overwrote data/st_scientific_training/{algo}/{variant}/training_record.json. All epoch_records had validation_loss=None. STConvergenceService had no backfill mechanism, so convergence was assessed as convergence_caveated or convergence_not_available instead of convergence_passed.

root_causes_identified.label: Hardcoded stale Markdown wording
root_causes_identified.description: Sections 9, 10, 11 of _profile_to_markdown() in STScientificEvidenceExportService used static strings ('before the scientific rerun') that were always emitted regardless of actual profile data, violating spec 4.5.

root_causes_identified.label: Missing consistency guard in SCI-FIX09
root_causes_identified.description: No guard existed to detect the contradiction where global algorithm_cards check (live STAlgorithmCardService) = PASS but algorithm-level check (stale CSV) = BLOCKED. Spec 4.4 required emitting internal_gate_consistency_error.

reports_regenerated: docs/exports/thesis/chapter06/06_st_gates/convergence_report.json (via: imputebench st training convergence report — with Phase B FIX02 backfill)
docs/exports/thesis/chapter06/08_scientific_evidence_profile/SCIENTIFIC_EVIDENCE_PROFILE.{json,md} + 14 coverage files (via: imputebench st evidence export --profile st_scientific_evidence_v1)
docs/exports/thesis/chapter06/09_scientific_gate/SCIENTIFIC_GATE_REPORT.{json,md} + CSV/blocker files (via: imputebench st scientific gate report)
docs/exports/thesis/chapter06/09_scientific_gate/ also verified via: imputebench st gate --profile scientific_ready

algorithm_card_ready.markdown_table: all four show ✅ in Card column

convergence_status.markdown: all four show convergence_passed in Convergence Summary section

sci_fix08_json_md_agreement.stale_wording_notes: Sections 9, 10, 11 now render dynamically from live profile data

final_launch_command: python -m imputebench st experiment run --tier a --dataset-id london_aq --graph-policy correlation_train_v1 --realizations 5 --epochs 100 --early-stopping --patience 15 --min-delta 0.0001 --min-epochs-before-early-stop 50 --checkpoint-policy best_validation_loss --validation-policy masked_validation_support --skip-completed --progress text --event-log data/logs/phase_c_v2_events.jsonl --progress-file data/logs/phase_c_v2_progress.json
official_campaign_launched_confirmation: NO — the official 120-run Phase C campaign was NOT launched during this repair. No experiment was executed.

code_changes.change: Added _backfill_validation_loss() and _load_phase_b_training_history() to recover Phase B FIX02 validation_loss from DB-indexed artifact directories when training_record.json has been overwritten by Phase C runs. Called in build_report() before assess_all_algorithms().
Replaced hardcoded stale Markdown wording in sections 9, 10, 11 of _profile_to_markdown() with dynamic content rendered from live profile algorithm data.

Added internal consistency guard (spec 4.4) after algorithm assessments: if global algorithm_cards_ready=PASS but any algorithm has algorithm_cards_not_ready in blocking_reasons, emit internal_gate_consistency_error.
Replaced stale test_gate_blocked_before_scientific_rerun with test_gate_passes_after_phase_b_fix02_and_fix01_alignment reflecting the correct post-FIX01 state.
